verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents bill capture with AI field extraction, routing for approval, PO-to-bill matching, and paying bills from one platform. However, the evidence never names the payment rails the story requires: there is no mention of check payments, and ACH or wire is only implied by generic global transfers. Missing for 10: explicit ACH, check, and wire vendor-payment methods, detail on approval-workflow configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can run accounts payable in the same platform — capture invoices, route approvals, and pay vendors by ACH, check, or wire

citations.quote: Simply attach your bill, then watch AI fill out accounting fields before routing it for approval.
Upload, manage, approve, and pay Canadian and international bills from one platform
Purchase orders automatically linked to bills and line items, giving you real-time visibility.
Make money transfers from the US to 200+ countries at interbank rates
